feeds.title: Jenjsilver
feeds.description: Author Jen Silver enjoys reading an eclectic range of genres including sci-fi, fantasy, historical fiction, and lesbian fiction. Read her latest musings and thoughts on this blog. She lives near Hebden Bridge in West Yorkshire, England with her long-term partner.

feeds.title: Our Taste For Life
feeds.description: Charlotte & Natalie, a free spirit lesbian couple on an adventure around the world. Sharing their budget backpacker travel guides, tips and more along the way.

feeds.title: Clare Lydon Blog
feeds.description: Clare Lydon is a lesbian fiction author and lover of Curly Wurlys. Her books have been described as 'romantic, addictive, fabulous!' and she couldn't have put it better herself. Check out her stories, new books, news and more!

feeds.title: Pink News
feeds.description: PinkNews covers politics, entertainment, religion and community news for the gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender community.

feeds.title: LesBeMums
feeds.description: We are LesBeMums, two wives from Brighton (UK) embarking on parenthood for the first time. We write about our lives in our blog, in particular our current journey through parenthood, how we got there, as well as our experiences as same-sex parents.

feeds.title: Meet the Wildes
feeds.description: Modern love story of two woman and their family. I'm Amber, and Meet the Wildes is a modern love story about two women who fell in love, and the family they made together. Mostly I write about my life with my partner, Kirsty, and our two sets of twins - boys born in October 14 and girls born in July 16.
